name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – After recital A – Am 5
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: Aa. whereas Mexico bears the primary and exclusive responsibility for safeguarding its internal security, maintaining public order, enforcing the rule of law, combating organised crime and drug trafficking, administering criminal justice and determining the organisation of its judiciary, including the method of appointment or election of judges and other judicial officials; whereas decisions concerning constitutional and judicial reforms fall within the sovereign competence of the Mexican people and their democratically elected institutions; whereas the EU should fully respect Mexico’s sovereignty and constitutional autonomy and refrain from interfering in matters falling within the competence of the Mexican authorities or seeking to impose external institutional models;
